 Dates
 Registration Begins: 22nd September 2026
 Problem Statements Release: 30th September 2026
 Development Period: 30th September to 14th October EOD
 Judging Period: 15th October to 20th October
 Final Showcase and Winner Announcement: 21st October 2026
 Eligibility
 Open to individuals aged 14 and above.
 Primarily intended for college students; all eligible individuals may apply.
 Inter-college teams are permitted.
 Team size: one to four members, including solo participation.
 One team can submit in only one track, and an individual may only be a member of one submitting team, you cannot join two teams in order to enter two tracks.
 Problem statements 
 click here 
 Prizes
 ₹1,00,000 in cash prize pool.
 Judging Criteria and Winner Selection
 Evaluated by an industry expert judging panel.
 One winner per track, four winners in total.
 Judging criteria of the respective problem statements are shared in the problem statement document itself
 AI Tools
 AI coding assistants are allowed with no restrictions. You may use Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, ChatGPT, v0, or any similar tool. You must disclose it: list the AI tools you used in Built With and note in your README which parts of the project were AI-assisted. Undisclosed use is treated as misrepresentation. You are responsible for everything you submit and must be able to explain how your code works if a judge asks.
